summary: A mixed day driven by regulatory developments and retail sector dynamics. FMCG distributors escalate UPI fee concerns to PM, while Jio's investor roadshow signals major IPO momentum for the retail/telecom landscape.

bullets.text: FMCG distributors petition PM for zero merchant discount rate on UPI transactions, citing cascading tax implications.
Reliance Jio begins investor meetings ahead of planned listing; NSE also eyeing IPO amid India's largest share offerings.
Fujifilm invests Rs 800 crore in semiconductor materials plant at Dholera Special Investment Region with Tata Electronics partnership.
Noel Tata objects to Tata Sons board conduct, deems Chandra vote null and void amid governance dispute.
Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceX AI, Google face federal antitrust lawsuit in Northern District Court of California for alleged illegal AI development coordination.
